title: Creamy Slovakian Tres Leches Cake
description: A moist and creamy Mexican-inspired dessert, made with Slovakian cream and a hint of Mexican spices.

ingredients.name: Slovakian cream
ingredients.notes: Heavy cream with a hint of Slovakian vanilla

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine Slovakian cream, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and salt.
Add bake mix and mix until just combined.
Pour batter into prepared baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Poke holes all over the top of the cake with a skewer.
Pour whipping cream over the top of the cake.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
